patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout featuring a large, fixed-position headline on the right and a vertical, sticky brand name on the left.
Dramatic contrast between oversized, high-contrast serif headings and clean, understated sans-serif body text and labels.
Bold, distinct color blocking used to define sections, transitioning between a warm off-white, deep indigo/navy, and bright yellow.

The main hero headline 'Don't be noisy, be interesting.' remains fixed in the viewport while the background scrolls behind it, creating a parallax effect. The text itself has a dynamic, animated gradient fill.
Content sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes, creating strong visual breaks and a sense of progression down the page.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a large, fixed-position text element that uses a video or animated gradient as its fill, creating a dynamic visual effect as the page scrolls and the background content moves beneath it.
A sticky navigation bar and a vertical brand identifier on the left edge remain visible throughout the scroll, providing persistent branding and access to navigation.
Content is structured using a clean grid system within distinct, full-bleed color blocks, ensuring clear separation and readability for each section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold serif headings (~5-6x body text) with a high contrast, paired with smaller, lighter sans-serif for body copy and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular elements with no visible corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous padding and line height, particularly in the hero and between major sections, creating a spacious and uncluttered feel).

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, fixed-position hero typography with an animated gradient fill, which creates a powerful and memorable first impression. The vertical, sticky brand name on the left also adds a unique and elegant touch, reinforcing brand presence without cluttering the main content area.
